name: FlopperZiro
description: A Flipper Zero clone, but cheapest, DIY and simply Open Source, made with Arduino IDE
readme_summary: FlopperZiro is an open-source, DIY, and cost-effective multi-tool inspired by the Flipper Zero, built on the Arduino IDE. It enables exploration of hardware protocols and wireless communication for electronics enthusiasts and hobbyists.
key_features: BadUSB (Rubber Ducky script execution)
RFID / NFC (Passive scanning and target emulation)
Infrared (IR) (Signal capture, replay, and SD persistence)
Sub-1 GHz (RF) (433 MHz signal capture, replay, and SD persistence)
Storage (Dynamic save and load functionality via MicroSD)
System Monitoring (Battery percentage and SD storage capacity tracking)
Development (Fully programmable via the Arduino IDE)
primary_use_case: A low-cost, DIY, open-source hardware multi-tool for learning and experimenting with various wireless communication protocols and hardware interfaces.
cover_image_prompt: A curious tinkerer, depicted as a friendly robot with glowing blue eyes, is assembling a compact, versatile gadget resembling a Swiss Army knife for the digital age. The gadget has various ports and an antenna, emitting subtle digital particles. Around the tinkerer, holographic projections display different types of signals being captured and manipulated: a radio wave, an NFC tag, and an infrared beam. In the background, a workbench is cluttered with electronic components and a 3D printer extruding a case. The overall mood is one of discovery and accessible technology, with a clean, bright aesthetic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with vibrant colors and clear, friendly iconography, subtly incorporating the 'FlopperZiro' name on a small screen.

name: skill-forge
description: Ultimate Claude Code skill creator — design, scaffold, build, review, evolve, and publish production-grade AI agent skills
readme_summary: Skill Forge is a comprehensive Python-based tool for designing, building, reviewing, evolving, and publishing production-grade AI agent skills that adhere to the Agent Skills open standard. It automates the entire skill development lifecycle, from initial planning and scaffolding to conversion for other platforms and performance benchmarking.
key_features: Plan skill architecture and complexity tiers
Scaffold complete skill file trees
Audit skills with a health score
Evolve skills based on feedback
Publish skills as .skill files
Convert skills for other AI platforms
Run evaluation pipelines with assertions
Benchmark skill performance
primary_use_case: To streamline and standardize the development of AI agent skills, making them production-ready and easily shareable across different platforms.
cover_image_prompt: A master craftsman in a futuristic workshop, meticulously assembling intricate clockwork components that represent AI agent skills. Gears and springs are replaced by glowing lines of code and abstract data streams. The craftsman uses a holographic blueprint to guide the assembly, with different tiers of complexity visually represented by the intricacy of the components. Small screens around the workshop display skill health scores and conversion progress. The overall mood is one of precision and innovation, with a clean, modern aesthetic and subtle digital particle effects. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with vibrant, glowing accents.

name: whisperbot
description: Telegram bot that transcribes audio messages via whisper.cpp
readme_summary: Whisperbot is a Telegram bot written in C that transcribes audio messages into text using either whisper.cpp or qwen-asr as the backend. It handles audio conversion, transcription processing, and streams the results back to the user, with options for managing queue length and switching between faster or higher-quality models.
key_features: Transcribes audio messages via Telegram
Supports whisper.cpp and qwen-asr backends
Handles audio downloading and conversion (WAV)
Streams transcription results back to Telegram
Manages ASR processing queue with a mutex and atomic counter
Switches between fast and best models based on queue length
Configurable limits for queue size, audio duration, and message length
primary_use_case: To provide users with a seamless way to transcribe voice messages sent to a Telegram bot into text.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic microphone character sitting at a Telegram chat interface. The microphone is actively 'listening' to a sound wave emanating from a user's voice bubble. As it listens, the microphone is simultaneously 'speaking' or emitting text bubbles that form a coherent sentence, representing the transcription. Subtle digital particles flow from the sound wave to the microphone, and then from the microphone to the text bubbles, indicating the data transformation. The background is a clean, abstract digital space with the repository name 'whisperbot' subtly integrated into the UI elements. The overall mood is helpful and efficient. Style: 3D isometric illustration with bright, clear colors and soft lighting.

name: FireRedVAD
description: A SOTA Industrial-Grade Voice Activity Detection & Audio Event Detection, supporting 100+ languages, outperforming Silero-VAD, TEN-VAD, FunASR-VAD and WebRTC-VAD
readme_summary: FireRedVAD is a state-of-the-art library for Voice Activity Detection (VAD) and Audio Event Detection (AED). It supports over 100 languages for speech, singing, and music detection, offering both streaming and non-streaming capabilities, and outperforms existing VAD solutions in accuracy and efficiency.
key_features: State-of-the-art Voice Activity Detection (VAD)
State-of-the-art Audio Event Detection (AED)
Supports non-streaming/streaming VAD
Supports non-streaming AED
Speech/singing/music detection
Supports 100+ languages
Outperforms leading VAD models (Silero-VAD, TEN-VAD, FunASR-VAD, WebRTC-VAD)
primary_use_case: Accurate and efficient detection of voice and audio events in multilingual audio streams for industrial applications.
cover_image_prompt: A highly detailed 3D isometric illustration of a sound engineer wearing futuristic headphones, standing in a control room filled with glowing audio waveforms. The engineer is pointing a sophisticated device, resembling a sonic scanner, at a complex audio mixing board. The scanner emits a beam of light that clearly separates distinct audio segments into two distinct streams: one labeled 'Speech/Music' with vibrant, flowing particles, and another labeled 'Silence' with a calm, muted aura. Small, subtle UI elements on the engineer's console display real-time VAD and AED metrics, with the 'FireRedVAD' logo subtly integrated into the console's design. The overall mood is one of precise control and advanced audio analysis, with a clean, modern aesthetic and a cool blue and purple color palette.

name: Shadowbroker
description: Open-source intelligence for the global theater. Track everything from the corporate/private jets of the wealthy, and spy satellites, to seismic events in one unified interface. Hook an AI agent up to have it parse through data and find previously unseen correlations. The knowledge is available to all but rarely aggregated in the open, until now.
readme_summary: ShadowBroker is a real-time geospatial intelligence platform that aggregates data from over 60 live intelligence feeds into a unified dark-ops map interface. It visualizes aircraft, ships, satellites, conflict zones, CCTV, and geopolitical events, with options for AI analysis of unseen correlations.
key_features: Real-time multi-domain OSINT telemetry aggregation
Unified dark-ops map interface
40+ toggleable data layers (SAR, Telegram OSINT, recon toolkit, cyber threat feeds)
Multiple visual modes (DEFAULT, SATELLITE, FLIR, NVG, CRT)
Server-side recon and Shodan queries with SSRF guards
OpenClaw / agent command channel for recon and telemetry search
No accounts, product telemetry, or analytics
primary_use_case: To aggregate and visualize diverse, real-time, public global intelligence data in a single interface for analysts, researchers, and operators, with capabilities for AI-driven correlation discovery.
cover_image_prompt: A master cartographer in a dimly lit, high-tech command center, hunched over a massive, holographic globe. The globe displays a dynamic, real-time overlay of global activity: glowing flight paths of aircraft, shimmering ship routes, blinking satellite orbits, and pulsating hotspots indicating geopolitical events. The cartographer is using a specialized stylus to draw connections between disparate data points, causing faint lines of light to appear, symbolizing the discovery of unseen correlations. Subtle UI elements showing data feeds and AI analysis progress are visible on surrounding screens. The overall mood is one of intense focus and discovery, with a color palette of deep blues, purples, and glowing data lines. Style: 3D isometric illustration with a focus on intricate detail and atmospheric lighting.
